products.name: Fried Chicken Curry
products.ingredients: Chicken breast (25 kyat-sized pieces), Salt, Black pepper, Cooking oil, Sugar, Tandoori masala (5 tablespoons), Garam masala (1 tbsp), Egg (1), Soy sauce, Bread crumbs (as needed)
products.instructions: Cut the chicken into small bite-sized pieces. Marinate with salt, pepper, sugar, and a bit of cooking oil, then refrigerate for 1 hour. Just before frying, mix with tandoori masala, garam masala, beaten egg, and soy sauce. Coat with breadcrumbs and deep fry in hot oil until golden. Serve with chili sauce or tamarind dip.
products.description: A popular Indo-Myanmar style deep-fried chicken curry.

products.name: Mohinga
products.ingredients: Rice noodles, Catfish, Lemongrass, Banana stem, Fish sauce, Chickpea flour, Onion, Garlic, Turmeric, Chili flakes
products.instructions: Boil catfish with lemongrass and banana stem to make broth. Fry onion, garlic, turmeric, and chili flakes. Mix with chickpea flour and broth. products.description: Myanmar’s national breakfast dish, made with rice noodles and fish soup.

products.name: Shan Noodles
products.ingredients: Flat rice noodles, Chicken or pork, Soybean paste, Garlic oil, Pickled mustard, Spring onion
products.instructions: Boil the noodles and prepare meat with soybean paste and garlic oil. Toss together with pickles and spring onions. Serve dry or with broth.
products.description: A traditional noodle dish from Shan State served dry or with soup.

products.name: Tea Leaf Salad
products.ingredients: Fermented tea leaves, Peanuts, Garlic, Tomato, Cabbage, Lime, Dried peas, Sesame seeds
products.instructions: Mix fermented tea leaves with all crunchy ingredients and fresh veggies. Squeeze lime and toss well. Serve as a salad or snack.
products.description: A tangy and crunchy fermented tea leaf salad, known as Lahpet Thoke.

products.name: Tofu Nway
products.ingredients: Shan tofu, Rice noodles, Garlic oil, Ground meat, Chili oil, Spring onions
products.instructions: Cook Shan-style tofu and serve hot over noodles with garlic oil, meat, and chili. Top with herbs.
products.description: A warm tofu noodle dish popular in northern Myanmar.

products.name: Coconut Noodle Soup
products.ingredients: Rice noodles, Coconut milk, Chicken, Onion, Garlic, Turmeric, Boiled egg, Crispy noodles
products.instructions: Make broth with coconut milk, turmeric, and chicken. Pour over boiled noodles. Top with egg and crispy noodles.
products.description: A creamy coconut chicken noodle soup known as Ohn No Khao Swe.

products.name: Fried Spring Rolls
products.ingredients: Spring roll wrappers, Mixed vegetables, Soy sauce, Pepper, Oil for frying
products.instructions: Stir-fry the filling, wrap in spring roll wrappers, and deep fry until golden. Serve with sweet chili sauce.
products.description: Crispy snack filled with vegetables and spices.

products.name: Milk Tea
products.ingredients: Black tea, Condensed milk, Evaporated milk, Sugar
products.instructions: Brew strong tea. Add condensed and evaporated milk. Stir and serve hot or iced.
products.description: Sweet Myanmar-style milk tea often served in tea shops.

products.name: Sticky Rice with Coconut
products.ingredients: Sticky rice, Coconut cream, Sugar, Salt, Sesame seeds
products.instructions: Steam sticky rice. Mix coconut cream with sugar and salt, then pour over rice. Top with sesame seeds.
products.description: A sweet breakfast or dessert made from coconut and glutinous rice.

products.name: Fried Tofu Snack
products.ingredients: Chickpea tofu, Oil, Garlic, Tamarind sauce
products.instructions: Slice tofu, deep fry until golden. Serve with garlic and tamarind dipping sauce.
products.description: Simple and crispy fried tofu pieces for a snack.

products.name: Nan Gyi Thoke
products.ingredients: Thick rice noodles, chicken curry, boiled egg, onions, chickpea flour, lime, coriander
products.instructions: Mix noodles with chicken curry sauce. Add sliced egg, onions, and chickpea flour. Garnish with coriander and lime.
products.description: Spicy noodle salad served as breakfast in Myanmar.

products.name: Pe Byouk with Paratha
products.ingredients: Boiled peas, onions, garlic, turmeric, salt, oil, paratha (flatbread)
products.instructions: Cook the peas until soft with turmeric, garlic, and onions. Mash slightly and season with salt. Serve warm with crispy paratha.
products.description: A classic Burmese breakfast of mashed peas served with flaky paratha.
